parents.name: Architectural scope, economic objectives, and policy authority
parents.detail: New-profile boundary, single authority, exact parameters and evidence limits; independent policy review pending.

parents.name: Historical postage baselines and delegated payment authorization
parents.detail: No Hashcash miner or micropayment authorization added. Puzzle authorization is labeled separately.

parents.name: Physical crypto stamps and postal delivery integration
parents.detail: No postal issuance, NFT stamp, CASS or physical delivery provider.

parents.name: Common virtual-envelope and postage lifecycle contracts
parents.detail: Game-tagged envelope, frozen draft, single-use READY/spent state and shared atomic delivery.

parents.name: UTXO conditional-penalty virtual postage
parents.detail: No UTXOs, OP_RETURN, public burn or complaint broadcast; game stamp is not a substitute.

parents.name: ERC-4337 smart accounts and Paymaster sponsorship
parents.detail: Existing local credit/sponsor accounting retained; no ERC-4337 wallet, bundler, EntryPoint or Paymaster deployed.

parents.name: Consensual paid inbox access and attention rewards
parents.detail: No EMT/EMC, advertiser funding, Read2Earn or attention reward.

parents.name: Addressing, interoperability, and message transport
parents.detail: Protected literal-loopback HTTP and local mailbox delivery; SMTP is disabled for protected vaults. No public DNS/MX or ENS/DID.

parents.name: Storage durability, retrieval, and provider exit
parents.detail: Encrypted local SQLite objects, signed references and tested backup/restore; no decentralized permanence claim.

parents.name: MLS and the article-described XMTP cryptographic profile
parents.detail: Ed25519 ledger/stamp signatures and ChaCha20-Poly1305 storage; no MLS/XMTP, post-quantum or end-to-end guarantee.

parents.name: Waku relay, RLN membership, and stake-based rate limits
parents.detail: Bounded requests and observer run limits are not RLN membership, proof generation or slashing.

parents.name: L3 appchain, settlement, and decentralization economics
parents.detail: Single-authority hash-linked local ledger; no L3, sequencer network, Base settlement or token emissions.

parents.name: ZK Email authentication and selective-disclosure execution
parents.detail: Exact SHA256 draft/trace commitments only; no DKIM circuit, SNARK or email-driven public contract.

parents.name: Sybil resistance and reward-abuse controls
parents.detail: Authentication, resource caps and one-run/horizon restrictions; no unique-human or economic-deterrence proof.

parents.name: Griefing, smart-contract resource safety, and trusted-infrastructure abuse
parents.detail: Bounded worker/events, transactional rollback, nonce history, stale-run and replay rejection; no HTLC or game-theory guarantee.

parents.name: Programmable finance within the inbox
parents.detail: Nonredeemable credits retained, game postage zero cost; no real invoice payments or external transfers.

parents.name: Correspondence evidence, privacy, erasure, and regulated-domain profiles
parents.detail: Encrypted correspondence, signed receipt/event separation and private backup; no legal delivery, GDPR erasure or clinical certification.

parents.name: Research validation and institutional acceptance
parents.detail: 113 executed tests plus bounded HTTP/upgrade/UI records; independent review, source acceptance and production gates not cleared.

scope: Local implementation dispositions are not source-control acceptance or authorized NOT_APPLICABLE decisions.
release_scope: Current local protected profile; historical deferred parent assessments remain distinct from native archive compatibility.
